item.title: Finished diary
item.description:
So, this morning I wanted to write about a dream I had that really resonated with me. Then when I opened this notebook I noticed it was the last page I could write on. It felt really weird. I had to keep my account of the dream brief but I did fit it all on that last page. But now, I need to get a need notebook.

Maybe I will just get a similar one. It was quite convenient and not all too complex. It was just a lined notebook that had a place on the top of each page where I could note down the date. Almost like it was meant to be a diary/journal.

item.title: Quick update
item.description:
I’m currently about halfway through Endymion and there was something really fun/interesting that I picked up on when I first started reading it.

As you may know (or not), I am 26 years old as of writing this. I am working at some whatever jobs doing fuck all and just living my life. Interestingly, Raul (the protagonist of the book) at the beginning is just some 27 year old dude who was living his life. For some reason, that really resonated with me. Even though, Raul is not real and the story is just some made up bullshit some guy thought would be cool to write down. It resonated.
